name: How can I prevent future drain clogs after a professional cleaning?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future drain clogs after a professional cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future drain clogs, avoid pouring grease down sinks, use drain screens to catch hair and food particles, and dispose of non-biodegradable items like wet wipes in the trash. For kitchen sinks, consider flushing drains with hot water after washing dishes to help move small debris. Regularly pouring a mixture of baking soda and vinegar followed by hot water can also help maintain drain clarity. Establishing these habits can significantly reduce the frequency of future clogs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent future clogs by avoiding grease, using drain screens, not flushing non-biodegradables, and regularly flushing with hot water or a baking soda/vinegar solution.
